title: Acme United to Present at the Sidoti Small-Cap Virtual Conference

body_markdown:
SHELTON, Conn., Sept. 16, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Acme United Corporation (NYSE American: ACU) today announced Acme United’s Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Walter Johnsen will present at the Sidoti Small-Cap Conference being held virtually on Wednesday, September 23, 2026.


The Company’s presentation will begin at 12:15 PM ET on Wednesday, September 23 and can be accessed[live here](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=oQTVGzEKUFRPr5HYV4fNx2zNRvkBRkc6Kd1NUUy7EqReAUx-E7jqi54tm19AdXG8L4DgYgW25EQQxrVlYBlOkm5NsDKVkNwusOeDkrb4Ro_vV-HI2kZMwhQnnDqA0eHEnWZUoeNyxIh82PmXncpunw==) . Acme United will also participate in virtual one-on-ones with investors on the same day.


**About Acme United**
**ACME UNITED CORPORATION** is a leading worldwide supplier of innovative safety solutions and cutting technology to the school, home, office, hardware, sporting goods and industrial markets. Its leading brands include[First Aid Only](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=pm4GtLIge39cHIrtSRx1xpVjCFOPgIpjAOn_9-DpdDF856-o957x7Mf8EZ-JtA7pKDckai3DqtS2YMgGpoIHNB4azh9JSUa5ZIUtFXeKgL0=) ®,[First Aid Central](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=pm4GtLIge39cHIrtSRx1xojrgsCOxduI4DmHHKTnOVuml9pCpZ8AhF1UBqmydve8LajZ311K8Q-Wwp8iuVxjvqqIEmQlj7lq1e0roSTXydM=) ®,[Physicians Care](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=bWVZS6WIZ50xQbkm3zOlMEzn3cvosidlBiEoO6Y5PDYM0S8GKSD-2DASOy6tZ5pFGWzghVHpiwMp11-xPKavius2ab5QQYwXxyYLA_tEmJl9UECQS90_ggapISyPXPQxMT8UcDR5AqeiamQVjIqESQ==) ®, Pac-Kit®,[Spill Magic](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=GektEdMNL-PkIaEQkU4q3KmJOotQ7wCEXaChXUBEZItjTmjMiPaIh2V724UK6WxAof-XX7KLR2ShgLIZg8GEbQ==) ®,[Westcott](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=lEv75CdRrmItkxELNtcBoTNeR31rH_EVYPdXpkEnIChWPXRKVM4QU2iMFMlfiH3W6GcEFfc0J0iHMHOLkS91xQ==) ®,[Clauss](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=DJMqWmNx2dvXG7MXZR8o4UjLHW2pBDbca2KsJXmv8YetlXPS696-NS6oTzbGOeWgDp8o6EbAqZnj5tbvfJAJNg==) ®,[DMT](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=-6sC3GJBFHH2oP6EjXJLkDVmVUqKaeMjXCTmTa34TS771TCxU8i9ygAIhE4Psm6vVw9fGUQdkeU2sjKZVTbJsQ==) ®,[Med-Nap](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=wScU8YAa53Zb-R743FPVUudPev9JnhJXNOnL3HfttOZjggEZ6jFv3ZlTCwz8wy4dSOgzTEcJ21uPM22YpAq4pw==) ®,[Elite First Aid](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=ryNxl2Ab99FcyvRpbb1DU_WBW84JfNa0IwHikQE-Y3P8V7hcx8MS3VdW55D8AtHiHTskWwcRnJcXHna45RRyu0Y6S_K0NV-hQ3H22DFVB2k=) ® and[My Medic](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=PCV9yZTCvznX4UoYmvD87X7uZP_INYrKG1_QeHV7i49YOhJNI7tFOzLTV9-kJN1U9vA04oj4HyqBsp41Rr1MQg==) ®.
